name: markdown-okf-schema-studio
description: Schema-aware Markdown editor and live preview for OKF bundles.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.scrollPr.description: Follow the editor viewport from the MyST preview.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.scrollEd.description: Reveal the source line represented by the MyST preview viewport.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.markEdit.description: Mark the active source line in the MyST preview.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.doubleCl.description: Reveal the mapped source line when rendered content is double-clicked.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.maxConte.description: Maximum width of the preview content column, in pixels. Set to 0 to use the full preview width.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.stickyHe.description: Number of Markdown heading levels to keep visible in the preview.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.incremen.description: Update the preview content in place while typing instead of reloading the page. Turn off if the preview misbehaves.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.plantuml.jarPath.description: Absolute path to plantuml.jar used for PlantUML previews. Leave empty to use the plantuml executable from PATH.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.prop.description: Show the frontmatter properties table at the top of the MyST preview.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.stri.description: Warn on frontmatter fields that are not present in the matching OKF schema.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.bund.description: Explicit bundle root for x-okf-link values. Relative paths are resolved from the first workspace folder.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.proj.description: Explicit project root for x-okf-link values. Relative paths are resolved from the first workspace folder.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.allo.description: Allow document-relative x-okf-link values to resolve outside workspace folders.

scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run test:unit && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:security
scripts.test:unit: mkdir -p out/reports/unit && node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=out/reports/unit/tests-unit.xml out/test/build/*.test.js out/test/configuration/*.test.js out/test/frontmatter/*.test.js out/test/mapping/*.test.js out/test/navigation/*.test.js out/test/rendering/*.test.js out/test/site/*.test.js out/test/state/*.test.js out/test/webview/*.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node out/test/integration/run-tests.js
scripts.test:scroll: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node out/test/integration/run-tests.js --scroll-only
scripts.test:reload: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node out/test/integration/run-tests.js --reload-only
scripts.visual:render: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node out/test/visual/renderFixtures.js
scripts.test:visual: npm run visual:render && uv run --no-sync --group docs python test/visual/capture.py
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node scripts/package-extension.mjs
